text_block_list.text:
As I'm heading to the cafeteria for lunch,
I see an
Umamusume who, for some
reason, is staring
intently at the other
students as they eat.
Stare...
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: I am observing everyone's behavior.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Yes. Simply by observing these
mealtimes, I can
gain insight into
everyone's priorities. For
example...
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Cake again, Creek? You might end up
regretting
those extra calories, you
know?
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
Well, it's lunchtime, after all. And they
do say
dessert is food for the soul.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You've barely had anything yourself,
Inari. You
only asked for a small portion
of soba. Is that
enough for you?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Y-yep, it's plenty! Finishing soba swiftly
is
considered the epitome of chic!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
As you can see... for racers, even daily
meals are
an essential part of training.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Which means there must be various
approaches
to them. I wish to
understand and learn from
these
perspectives.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
At the dojo, it was commonplace to
learn by
watching other students train,
you see.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list: So what's your own approach to meals?

text_block_list.text:
I prioritize nutritional balance. I strive
not to
become too accustomed to luxury
or gourmet
foods.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
However, I imagine others have their
own ways of
thinking. And the more
exceptional the runner,
the more
steadfast her philosophies...
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: What's this?!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm starving.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Oguri... A top-notch talent, indeed. I
must
carefully observe her choices.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: Hmmm, what to choose, what to choose?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Right. I'll start with the miso mackerel
set.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Hm, she chose the same meal I did.
Mackerel is
rich in nutrients, so I assume
Oguri must also
value hea—
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: Ten portions should do it.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely need some hamburger
steaks too.
Five plates of those. And five
portions of the
extra-large katsudon.
Oh, they have rice balls
too.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Those would go well with pickled
vegetables...
Hmmm, katsudon alone just
isn't enough fried
food... I'd better grab
some fried chicken too.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
...I can't make sense of it! What could
possibly
compel Oguri to order such
copious—
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: Ah! Could it be?!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Is she... using these meals as a way to
test her
limits?!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
That would explain why she's eating so
much!
Have I been underestimating the
significance of
meals all along?!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
I will not fall behind! I'll follow her lead
and go for
seconds!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list:
Eating an amount that's right for you is probably
best...

text_block_list.text: Osu! The time has come to dig in!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! I'd like five more portions of
the
tatsuta fried chicken and three more
of the ginger
pork set!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: You're going in for more too, Yaeno?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Oguri. You have opened my eyes.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Not even my stomach can be allowed to
lag
behind! I must catch up!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: What? Catch up? Ketchup...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're right... I, too, have my own
thoughts
and reasoning behind my meal
choices...
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
When it comes to martial arts, wavering
and
being fickle achieves nothing... I
almost strayed
from my path and lost
sight of myself there.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: Hmmm... That said...
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: Hm... Now what about dessert?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I'll have donuts, cheese tarts, crepes...
And I'll
throw some fruits in for a
refreshing touch...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Oguri is truly to be feared. Her meal
choices
alone shake me to my core. I
have much to learn...
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
...I should try some on my fried chicken.
And I'm
ordering some of that ginger
pork too.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп
